svg.text: All 36 application tables · All 61 enforced foreign keys · 12 November 2026
Colored cards = main tables. Gray cards = repeated parent references; the section number locates the main table.
PK = primary key FK = foreign key ? = nullable | = one o = optional/zero crow’s foot = many
Keys shown for clarity. Every relationship appears in its child table’s section; JSON/text links are not database foreign keys.
Source: live nebula_knowlab PostgreSQL schema. This diagram contains schema metadata only, not learner or credential data.
